response.overview: Shin Godzilla: ORTHOchromatic is a black-and-white version of the 2016 film Shin Godzilla. Proposed by Hideaki Anno and overseen by director Shinji Higuchi and associate director Katsuro Onoue, it renders the film in orthochromatic-style monochrome, with stark contrast and deep, pronounced blacks. It premiered in Japan on October 27, 2023, as part of a special series of Godzilla screenings celebrating the release of Godzilla Minus One.
